title: A date arithmetic tool
request:
Add an MCP tool named days_between that takes from and to (ISO dates such as
"2024-02-28") and answers {"days": n}, the number of days from the first to the
second, negative when the second is earlier. A string that is not a valid ISO
date is an error. Put the logic in lib/dates.ts as an exported function
daysBetween(from: string, to: string): number that throws an Error for an invalid
date, and write tests for it.
